properties.description: The enforcement req:the-mcp-server-keeps-working-as-is-and-door-improvements-are-additive-or-opt-in recommends: a CI gate that fails when an existing tool's input schema or reply shape is renamed, removed or given a new meaning, while a new tool, field or line passes. THE INPUT-SCHEMA HALF EXISTS: tools/toolsnap.py diffs every served tool's schema and description against the committed goldens in tools/toolsnaps/ on every push, so such a change is a reviewed diff. THE REPLY-SHAPE HALF DOES NOT: nothing pins which fields a reply carries or what they mean, so additivity is held today by review and by tests a change writes for itself (for loop_status, an_up_to_date_store_says_nothing_new). PLANNED, NOT APPROVED: Anthony has not approved building the reply-shape gate (2026-10-05). It is recorded so the requirement is not left satisfied by nothing, and building it waits on his word.
properties.name: An existing tool's input schema and reply shape are pinned, so a change made for the --call door cannot silently break an MCP client
